mentions.claim_text: He points to reports of Russia training newly recruited North Korean troops for offensive operations in Ukraine as fulfilment of his earlier word to watch North Korea send its troops to Russia.
mentions.quote: Watch what he does with his troops, sending them to Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Confirmed reporting that North Korean troops are in Russia being trained for Ukraine operations.
mentions.falsify_miss: No North Korean troop presence in Russia, or the reports are retracted.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw moles inside the Cuba effort who were lying to Rubio, people Rubio trusted who were actually bad, and reads a new CIA Bay of Pigs task force as confirmation.
mentions.quote: I saw these moles and they were lying to Rubio
mentions.falsify_match: Named officials in the Cuba policy circle are identified as having deceived the Secretary of State.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such deception surfaces and the Cuba effort proceeds without an insider leak scandal.

mentions.claim_text: He reads a presidential post referencing Camp David and Kennedy as coded confirmation of a Cuba cold war, and says he knows the president is watching.
mentions.quote: Do you remember this cold war alliance is Camp David
mentions.falsify_match: The administration confirms a Cuba posture deliberately modelled on the 1962 crisis.
mentions.falsify_miss: The post has no Cuba content and no such posture emerges.

mentions.claim_text: He says the real Cuban danger is not the Bay of Pigs but drones and a dirty thing given by Russia in Castro's time, encased in lead in the side of a mountain, which he says is alive.
mentions.quote: a dirty thing from Russia from when Castro was in it
mentions.falsify_match: A Soviet-era radiological or biological device is found in a Cuban mountain facility.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such device exists or is ever found.

mentions.claim_text: He restates that Japan will be split down the middle and that Mount Fuji will erupt in a major eruption that kills many, with a lot of people seen going home.
mentions.quote: Japan would be split down the middle and it will have a major eruption
mentions.falsify_match: Mount Fuji erupts with mass casualties.
mentions.falsify_miss: Fuji stays quiet and no Japanese eruption kills at scale.

mentions.claim_text: He treats a Russian strike on Kyiv as matching what he had been shown, though the footage shown is of an Amazon logistics facility rather than the target he had named.
mentions.quote: So, Russia struck Kiev. So, we know what the Lord has showed us
mentions.falsify_match: The strike matches a specific target he named in advance.
mentions.falsify_miss: The strike is an ordinary continuation of a nightly campaign with no named target matched.

mentions.claim_text: Continuing on the Kyiv strike, he says Russia will hit logistics and delivery infrastructure rather than oil, joking about no more overnight deliveries and no more blue trucks.
mentions.quote: It's no more at your oil. It's at your Amazon facility
mentions.falsify_match: Russian strikes shift measurably from energy to civilian logistics targets.
mentions.falsify_miss: Energy infrastructure remains the primary Russian target set.

mentions.claim_text: He cites Black Sea port strikes hurting Ukrainian shipping as the warning he gave, and repeats that Turkey will take over the strait into the Black Sea in the days ahead and come out as a vampire.
mentions.quote: Turkey would take over the Black Sea in the strait in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey closes the strait to shipping and asserts control of Black Sea transit.
mentions.falsify_miss: The Montreux arrangement holds and transit continues normally.

mentions.claim_text: He shows footage of a woman in Japan objecting loudly to a mosque being built, and laughs at her delivery without drawing a forward claim from it.
mentions.quote: to build a mosque and this Asian woman is going nuts
mentions.falsify_match: Organised Japanese resistance to mosque construction becomes a recognised national issue.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip stays a one-off local dispute.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the president takes no counsel from the ungodly, finishes strong, and is surrounded by people led by the spirit rather than people of a reprobate mind.
mentions.quote: We thank you Lord that he finishes strong
mentions.falsify_match: The president completes the term without a collapse of his inner circle.
mentions.falsify_miss: The administration ends early or its senior staff turn on him.

mentions.claim_text: He calls for an uncovering across the country, declaring every plot and plan brought to nothing from sea to shining sea.
mentions.quote: every plot, every plan across this land to be uncovered
mentions.falsify_match: A run of major American conspiracies is exposed publicly.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such wave of exposure occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for a brand new David to rise in Israel, a warrior and not weak, who stands for Jewish traditions and protects the homeland.
mentions.quote: that Israel would have a brand new David rise up
mentions.falsify_match: A new Israeli leader emerges who is publicly cast in that warrior mould.
mentions.falsify_miss: Israeli leadership continues along its existing lines with no such figure.

mentions.claim_text: He asks that the current prime minister remain until God is done with him, and repeats twice that he has seen a new David, alongside a prayer that named American politicians be replaced.
mentions.quote: let BB still be there until the time that you want him to be done
mentions.falsify_match: Netanyahu leaves office and a figure matching the description succeeds him.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such succession occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a giant acorn being planted at an American flag at the top of rubble at ground zero, and asks what the acorn means rather than interpreting it.
mentions.quote: The acorn is trying to be planted at the ground zero
mentions.falsify_match: An acorn monument or emblem appears at a site of destruction in New York.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such object or event materialises and the image stays uninterpreted.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a New York building on fire at the 41st floor overlooking Central Park, and ties the number to the forty first president rather than to a storey.
mentions.quote: the building on fire looking over Central Park at the 41st floor
mentions.falsify_match: A fire at a Central Park facing building involving its 41st floor.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such fire occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He sees again a major flood of water coming inland from the east coast, flooding into New York past the towers, with destruction from a tsunami wave.
mentions.quote: I see water flooding inland into New York
mentions.falsify_match: A tsunami or storm surge floods lower Manhattan.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such inundation of New York occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He asks the audience to remember the eerie feeling of the empty sky the night after the September 2001 attacks, twenty five years ago, as the feeling America is about to have again.
mentions.quote: Do you remember the feeling that America felt like that moment
mentions.falsify_match: An event on American soil produces a nationwide shutdown comparable to September 2001.
mentions.falsify_miss: No comparable national event occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when this time frame arrives he sees baseball and football still being played while fires burn and uncertainty spreads among people.
mentions.quote: I see fires. I see an uncertainty in people
mentions.time_phrase: when you get there to this time frame
mentions.falsify_match: Widespread American fires and unrest run alongside an uninterrupted sports season.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such period of fires and uncertainty occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says a shaking is coming to America, Europe, Australia and Asia, and that on the Sunday he sees the churches will not have room for everyone, with people standing in the foyer.
mentions.quote: the churches won't have enough room to put all the people
mentions.falsify_match: American church attendance surges past building capacity following a national shock.
mentions.falsify_miss: Attendance stays flat or continues its decline.

mentions.claim_text: He says the shaking will run from the Gulf to Canada and across all Canada, and tells the audience to watch what God is about to do in Mexico.
mentions.quote: Watch what God is about to do in Mexico
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised religious revival movement emerges in Mexico.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing notable occurs in Mexican church life in this period.

mentions.claim_text: He shows candidates for American senate and congressional seats calling for Palestine to be freed, and says sarcastically that the audience might vote for them.
mentions.quote: These are the ones that are running for office
mentions.falsify_match: Candidates with that platform win federal seats in numbers.
mentions.falsify_miss: Such candidates remain marginal and lose.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a socialist leading the Texas Senate race as what the Lord was showing about a shaking of the nation, and says there will be battleground states.
mentions.quote: he's winning just like the Lord was showing us
mentions.falsify_match: The Texas Senate seat is won by the socialist candidate.
mentions.falsify_miss: Texas holds the seat for the Republicans.

mentions.claim_text: He notes that the pillow company founder has resigned as chief executive to focus only on the Minnesota governor's race, putting Minnesota first.
mentions.quote: decided to resign from his company as CEO
mentions.falsify_match: Lindell wins the Minnesota governorship.
mentions.falsify_miss: He loses the primary or the general.

mentions.claim_text: On Russian missile strikes in Kyiv he says North Korean weapons are being used, and restates that the North Korean leader will come out of his bunker as a social pariah.
mentions.quote: He's really going to come out of the basement, out of a bunker
mentions.falsify_match: Kim Jong-un takes a prominent public international role.
mentions.falsify_miss: He remains as reclusive as before.

mentions.claim_text: He reads reports of Russian ballistic missile and drone strikes damaging civilian logistics sites in Kyiv as matching what he was shown about the days ahead.
mentions.quote: this is what the Lord showed us concerning
mentions.falsify_match: A named logistics target he specified in advance is struck.
mentions.falsify_miss: Only routine strikes occur with no advance specificity matched.

mentions.claim_text: He cites a Ukrainian strike hitting a Turkish vessel as the start of Turkey getting involved, and repeats that Turkey beats its war drums, becomes a vampire and closes off the strait.
mentions.quote: Turkey starts to beat its war drums in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey enters the war militarily and shuts the strait.
mentions.falsify_miss: Turkey stays out and transit continues.

mentions.claim_text: He names shakings on the Mississippi, in the upper states, in Cuba, in Oklahoma and on the Texarkana, with signs and wonders and things happening with the sun.
mentions.quote: shakings on the Mississippi, shaking in Cuba, shaking in Oklahoma
mentions.falsify_match: Felt earthquakes occur in several of those named places in one period.
mentions.falsify_miss: No notable seismic activity in those places.

mentions.claim_text: Placed in Europe, he sees fire around the Ukrainian president, and recalls a golden quill pen with which the president would sign crypto law into place.
mentions.quote: I see fire around Zalinski
mentions.falsify_match: Zelensky faces a direct attack or a crisis that removes him.
mentions.falsify_miss: He continues in office without such an event.

mentions.claim_text: He names JP Morgan, Bank of America, Wells Fargo and BlackRock, with BlackRock off to the side, and says embarrassing days lie ahead for certain banks.
mentions.quote: I see JP Morgan. I see Bank of America. I see Wells Fargo
mentions.falsify_match: One of the named banks suffers a public embarrassment or scandal.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such episode at any of the named institutions.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Japan, South Korea and Taiwan, with a closed red tulip rising up out of Japan into a digital world of codes and the repeated word Chrome.
mentions.quote: I see this tulip rising up out of Japan
mentions.falsify_match: A Japanese digital asset platform whose emblem is a tulip becomes prominent across east Asia.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such platform emerges and the image stays uninterpreted.

mentions.claim_text: Continuing the same vision, he repeats the codes and the word Chrome several times and says emergings, without saying what they refer to.
mentions.quote: The codes. The codes. Chrome. The chrome
mentions.falsify_match: A specific protocol or browser standard he names retrospectively matches the imagery.
mentions.falsify_miss: The words never resolve to anything identifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He sees neon coloured shapes merging: cryptocurrencies and tech companies using each other like building blocks.
mentions.quote: I see cryptos. I see tech, a lot of tech
mentions.falsify_match: A visible wave of crypto and technology consolidation and integration.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such wave; the sectors stay separate.

mentions.claim_text: Praying into Israel, he sees fields of wheat ready to harvest in the fall, and notes that the fall is not the normal time to harvest wheat.
mentions.quote: A harvest is coming in the fall
mentions.falsify_match: A marked ingathering, spiritual or agricultural, in Israel in autumn.
mentions.falsify_miss: Autumn passes with nothing of the kind.

mentions.claim_text: He restates major shakings from a terrorist attack and foreign invaders in a red dawn experience across America, Europe and Asia, with facial scanning required to enter Walmart and Target.
mentions.quote: you will not be able to go into Walmart into Target
mentions.falsify_match: Major American retailers require facial recognition for entry.
mentions.falsify_miss: Retail entry remains open without biometric gating.

mentions.claim_text: He says megachurches will comply with facial scanning of their congregations during worship, refusing entry to those not approved, with address and social security number attached and authorities alerted.
mentions.quote: I saw mega churches complying with this to scan their congregation
mentions.falsify_match: American megachurches adopt facial recognition entry tied to identity records.
mentions.falsify_miss: No megachurch does so.

mentions.claim_text: Recounting a prior vision, he says Ebola takes hold of the Middle East in the days ahead, and separately that he saw a major earthquake at Yellowstone with the geysers boiling more.
mentions.quote: take hold of Europe. I'm not Europe. Middle East in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: An Ebola outbreak is recorded in a Middle Eastern country.
mentions.falsify_miss: Ebola stays confined to Africa.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord asked him to watch San Francisco, and saw men without shirts weeping before the Lord, which he states refers to homosexuality, with Portland, Seattle and British Columbia alongside.
mentions.quote: Watch what I'm about to do in San Francisco
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised religious revival movement emerges in San Francisco.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing of the kind occurs in that city.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a big brown bear while praying over California, and that his son afterwards pointed out that the California state flag carries a bear.
mentions.quote: I saw a big brown bear. A big brown bear
mentions.falsify_match: Events in California retrospectively match a bear as a symbol he assigns meaning to.
mentions.falsify_miss: The image stays a symbol with no assigned or matched meaning.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for pastors, evangelists and prophetic voices to be stirred for accuracy rather than flakiness, and for hearts to be stirred across Asia, Australia and Africa.
mentions.quote: You stir for accuracy, not flakiness
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable improvement in the accuracy of prophetic claims in that movement.
mentions.falsify_miss: No change; the same rate of unmatched claims continues.

mentions.claim_text: He calls for urgency inside the church, naming it the midnight hour to wake the bride, across America, Canada, Mexico, South America and Africa.
mentions.quote: an urgency inside of the church, the midnight hour to wake up the bride
mentions.falsify_match: A visible worldwide surge in church urgency and attendance.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such surge.

mentions.claim_text: He declares the Ebola outbreak stopped, saying it will go away even faster than it came on and will no longer keep killing people.
mentions.quote: just as fast as it come on, it's going to go away even faster
mentions.falsify_match: The outbreak is declared over within weeks with a low final death toll.
mentions.falsify_miss: The outbreak grows or persists for months.

mentions.claim_text: He praises Italy for stopping migrant arrivals, and says that without it Sharia law comes in and there will be no Europe left.
mentions.quote: there won't be a Europe
mentions.falsify_match: Sharia-based law is adopted in a European jurisdiction.
mentions.falsify_miss: European legal systems remain unchanged.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees an anointing on Byron Donalds, wants him as Florida governor, but does not think he will be long lived there because he will be promoted, maybe not this time.
mentions.quote: I don't think he'll be long lived there. I think he's going to get promoted
mentions.falsify_match: Donalds leaves the governorship early for higher federal office.
mentions.falsify_miss: He serves a full term or never becomes governor.

mentions.claim_text: He calls the battleground states, Oklahoma and Texas as important as the presidential race, and repeats the reprieve, asking what the audience will do with the time given.
mentions.quote: I give you a reprieve and what will you do with the time
mentions.falsify_match: A period of relative calm holds through the stated window.
mentions.falsify_miss: The reprieve is interrupted by a national catastrophe.

mentions.claim_text: He says Harris will try to rebrand herself and will get no traction, and restates that the Lord said Cuba will be liberated and shaken with a major revival.
mentions.quote: Harris will try to rebrand herself and I do not see her getting any traction
mentions.falsify_match: Harris attempts a comeback and it fails to gain support.
mentions.falsify_miss: She mounts a competitive national campaign.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a report that Iran held a call with Turkey to discuss the war with America, and says he wonders what will come out of it.
mentions.quote: Iran holds call with Turkey to discuss US Iran war
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey and Iran coordinate militarily against American action.
mentions.falsify_miss: The call leads nowhere.

mentions.claim_text: He says he keeps seeing France and others wanting to give Ukraine long range missiles to poke the bear, and tells the audience to watch what happens.
mentions.quote: want to give them like long range missiles to really poke the bear
mentions.falsify_match: France transfers long range strike missiles to Ukraine and Russia escalates in response.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such transfer occurs.

mentions.claim_text: On footage of Iranian drones over Kuwait shot down by Kuwaiti air defence, he says he sees multiple drones and confirms they are drones rather than aircraft.
mentions.quote: I see multiple drones
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian drone attacks on Kuwait and American bases continue and widen.
mentions.falsify_miss: The episode stays isolated.

mentions.claim_text: He says America is about to use EMPs on Iran after a public debate about it, and that he then saw troops taking an island and a debated ground invasion.
mentions.quote: they're going to use EMPs on Iran in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: American forces employ an electromagnetic pulse weapon against Iran.
mentions.falsify_miss: No EMP is used and no ground invasion is attempted.

mentions.claim_text: He says something is off about the children when he prays about Israel, that he does not know what it is and will not touch it, and repeats that a new leader will take the helm of Israel.
mentions.quote: There's something wrong when I pray about the children
mentions.falsify_match: A scandal involving children in Israel surfaces and a new leader takes over.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that America, Canada, Australia and Europe will not become Islamic and will not have Sharia law, calling the church to rise up and pray.
mentions.quote: We're not going to have Sharia law in America
mentions.falsify_match: No Sharia-based law is adopted in any of the named countries.
mentions.falsify_miss: Any of them adopts a Sharia-based legal provision.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the power grid, substations, water, sewers, gas plants and oil plants that no cyber attack from any foreign or domestic source will come near.
mentions.quote: no cyber attacks from any foreign nation or even domestic will come nigh
mentions.falsify_match: No successful cyber attack takes down American grid or water infrastructure.
mentions.falsify_miss: A cyber attack causes a significant utility outage.

mentions.claim_text: He says the glory will roll out with permanent hot spots or stations that will always be there, naming Branson, Collinsville, Fort Worth, places in California, Tennessee and up north.
mentions.quote: There'll be hot spots of the glory that will always be there
mentions.falsify_match: Sustained revival meetings become established at several of those named places.
mentions.falsify_miss: No lasting movement at any of them.

mentions.claim_text: He declares the Ebola outbreak will not keep spreading person to person, will not take the whole continent of Africa and will not go into Egypt or the Middle East, seeing Egypt as very strong.
mentions.quote: It will not go into Egypt. It will not keep going this way
mentions.falsify_match: Ebola is contained within its current countries with no Egyptian or Middle Eastern cases.
mentions.falsify_miss: Ebola cases are recorded in Egypt or a Middle Eastern country.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts being taken in vision from Africa through the sky in a tube and landing on the California coast, with the Lord saying now you are going to California.
mentions.quote: Now you're going to California
mentions.falsify_match: A California move of God follows, matching what he says he was shown there.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing follows in California.
